titleZh: 納入 ↔ 排除｜貴賓繩對拒馬
hook: embrace／encompass 拉開貴賓繩請你進來，exclude／ostracize／shun 擺拒馬——門口保全問：名單上有你嗎？
script: 納入隊：embrace／encompass／incorporate／comprise。排除隊：exclude／ostracize／shun／bar／banish。口令：貴賓繩寫「歡迎入內」，拒馬寫「請改走後門」。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 貴賓繩: embrace walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「貴賓繩」出場：embrace 一上場梗就黏住——擁抱接納。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 大圈: encompass walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「大圈」出場：encompass 一上場梗就黏住——涵蓋。

members.senseAnchor: make into a whole or make part of a whole; include or contain; have as a component

members.senseAnchor: expel from a community or group; avoid speaking to or dealing with
